skill_name: Identify five ways to recycle plastic.
workflow: Five ways to recycle plastic are by reusing and donating plastic items, looking for recyclable materials such as PET (polyethylene terephthalate), taking part in community clean-ups, joining an organization that works in plastic recycling, and creating art out of plastic. Reusing and donating plastic items is a great way to extend the lifetime of the plastic, reducing the need for further production.
